about: #4463: the det ports `proof_sweep.py --det-only` does not prove, each with the issue that owns it. A two-way ratchet: CI fails on a port not listed here that is not proven, and on a listed port that is now proven. When a fix lands, run `python tests/tools/proof_sweep.py --det-only --skip-db2 --work DIR --update-baseline` and commit the shortened file; a new entry is only ever added by hand, with its true cause.
